blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte resumed Thursday for its 44th day after a week-long adjournment for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, with the defense presenting former Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) investigator and certified public accountant Rainer Dela Fuente as its key witness on financial investigation rules and bank confidentiality under the Anti-Money Laundering Act. Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo challenged the need for Dela Fuente’s testimony on bank confidentiality, telling the witness, “You’re not needed here, if you think about it,” and citing the Bank Secrecy Law’s existing exception for impeachment cases.
